edges.reason: initialize() authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the stored initializer address.
setIndex() is guarded by onlyManager, which compares _owner with msg.sender.
rebase() is guarded by onlyStakingContract, which compares msg.sender to stakingContract.
transfer() debits the gon balance of msg.sender.
transferFrom() spends msg.sender's allowance via _allowedValue[from][msg.sender].
permit() checks block.timestamp against the user-supplied deadline.
_storeRebase() writes block.timestamp into the LogSupply event, creating timestamp dependence.
rebase() recomputes and writes _gonsPerFragment from the new total supply.
rebase() increases _totalSupply by the computed rebase amount.
rebase() calls the internal _storeRebase() to persist the rebase record.
rebase() calls circulatingSupply() to size the rebase.
circulatingSupply() calls balanceOf() for the staking contract.
transfer() mutates the _gonBalances entries of sender and recipient.
transferFrom() subtracts from _allowedValue[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() moves gons between _gonBalances entries.
approve() writes the spender allowance into _allowedValue.
_approve() is the internal approval hook that writes _allowedValue.
permit() calls _approve() after validating the signature.
permit() hashes DOMAIN_SEPARATOR into the signed struct.
setIndex() stores the gons-converted index into INDEX.
sendValue() transfers control to an arbitrary recipient through a low-level value call.
functionCallWithValue() transfers control to an arbitrary target with value attached.
functionDelegateCall() executes arbitrary target code in the caller's context.
increment() performs counter._value += 1 with native unchecked arithmetic.
rebase() performs multiplication and division to derive rebaseAmount and _gonsPerFragment.
The low-level value call invokes the attacker-controlled recipient parameter as a callback.
The low-level call invokes the attacker-controlled target parameter as a callback.
renounceManagement() writes the privileged _owner slot.
pullManagement() overwrites _owner with _newOwner after checking msg.sender.
pushManagement() stages the new privileged address in _newOwner.
The profit_ parameter flows into the multiplication/division that computes the rebase amount.
The value parameter is scaled by _gonsPerFragment and applied to gon balances.
The stakingContract_ parameter is stored in the stakingContract state variable.
The local rebaseAmount is derived and added to _totalSupply inside rebase().
The recovered signer local must equal owner for permit() to grant an allowance.
increaseAllowance() adds to the caller's _allowedValue entry.
decreaseAllowance() subtracts from the caller's _allowedValue entry.
_mint() adds to _totalSupply using SafeMath inside the base ERC20 contract.
The base ERC20 _transfer() moves balances used by the derived token accounting.
The amount parameter is approved to the spender inside permit().
The local gonValue is the product of value and _gonsPerFragment used by transfer().

The parameter is only consumed by setIndex() when writing INDEX.
The parameter feeds the rebase arithmetic inside rebase().
The parameter is only used for event emission and rebase bookkeeping inside rebase().
The parameter is only read by _storeRebase() to compute rebasePercent.
The parameter is only used as the credit target inside transfer().
The parameter is converted to gons and applied to balances inside transfer()/transferFrom().
The parameter identifies the debited account inside transferFrom().
The parameter is only used as the allowance key inside approve().
The parameter is part of the signed struct validated inside permit().
The parameter is the allowance value applied by permit() through _approve().
The parameter is the callee of the low-level call performed by functionCallWithValue().
The parameter is the recipient of the low-level value call performed by sendValue().
The local variable is produced and consumed entirely within rebase().
The local cache is computed from circulatingSupply() and used only inside rebase().
The local variable is computed and consumed entirely within transfer().
The local variable is only used for the signature check inside permit().
The parameter is only used as the credited account inside _mint().
The parameter is only used as the debited account inside ERC20 _transfer().
